effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, by trashing 1 [Cyborg] or [Ver.2] trait card from your hand, reduce the play cost by 2.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card from your trash face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, from 1 of your opponent's Digimon, trash any 1 digivolution card for each of this Digimon's face-down digivolution cards. Then, return 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon unsuspends.
